verdict.rationale: Orb's docs state UI/API parity for several core workflows: creating subscriptions (orb-docs-8), editing subscription pricing, add-ons, seats and discounts (orb-docs-31), and manually issuing draft invoices via dashboard or API (orb-docs-34). A mature API surface backs this up: official SDKs in six languages, idempotency, pagination, an alerts endpoint and event ingestion (orb-docs-24 to orb-docs-29). There is no blanket statement that everything in the UI is available through the API, and no published OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths (orb-docs-31 notwithstanding, orb-probe-2 returned 404s). Missing for 10: an explicit claim of full UI/API parity, API coverage evidence for areas like metric creation, pricing simulations, exports and revenue reporting, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
